In fact, studies suggest that ART conception was not significantly associated with an increased risk of preterm birth due to congenital anomalies.

However, total prevalence of severe congenital anomalies would not be adequately assessed if termination of pregnancy is considered. It is also noted that rescue abortion may apply to only a subset of cases and more likely candidates are identified in specific subsets.

Therefore, the final answer to this question is that there is no significant difference in the probability of prenatal diagnosis or termination of pregnancy between fetuses conceived using assisted reproductive technologies (ART) and those conceived naturally.
